LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Assembly_Carapace.label: kwazaari assembly carapace
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Assembly_Carapace.description: A rigid carapace built around the principle of sustained surgical control. Its alloy structural web locks the torso and shoulders into a configuration optimized for continuous bionic implant work at the highest precision tier. Unlike the harness of the solar craftsman, this piece does not compromise — it is built for one purpose, and it excels at it.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FlakPants.label: kwazaari flak pants
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FlakPants.description:
A pair of conventional pants with kwazaari armor plates sewn in to protect the legs from all manners of assault. Comes with optional kneepads and codpiece to protect any and all parts of the humanoid body*.
*kneepads and codpiece sold separately
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Masterforge_Mantle.label: kwazaari masterforge mantle
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Masterforge_Mantle.descriptio: A heavy-grade kwazaari alloy coat that integrates forge-dampening weave with bionic assembly stabilizers along the shoulder seams. Worn by specialists who move between high-heat substrate work and delicate implant installation without changing out of their kit.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PowerArmor.label: kwazaari marine armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PowerArmor.descriptio: A suit of Powered Armor made from Quasar Alloy. Armor of this caliber in military use is often on strict lend-lease as the inevitable god-complex one acquires while wearing it is considered 'problematic' and/or 'extremely annoying' by most Kwazaari Quartermasters.
